context: 30 second ad in a stylized 3D animated style. A tiny old owl, Mabel, keeps a lighthouse. On the coldest, foggiest night a ferry captain, Teo, radios her. She keeps her tea in an Ember Mug 2 (page claims: set an exact drinking temperature, so your coffee is never too hot or too cold; maintains your chosen temperature for up to 1.5 hours), cranks the lamp to full and guides the ferry home.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the coldest, foggiest night of the year, Mabel keeps watch alone.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Point Hollow, I can't see a thing. Are you there?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Long nights call for warm tea, so Mabel keeps hers in an Ember Mug, set to the exact temperature she likes.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: I see your light! Thank you, Mabel.
